summary: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. filed an 8-K covering its second-quarter 2026 results (revenue of $271 million, 60% gross margin, $109 million operating cash flow) and a corporate presentation, furnished under Item 7.01. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or personnel change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings and investor-relations update for a cannabis operator. The registrant is Trulieve, acting solely as the reporting issuer. There are no deal terms, advisors, or premium figures to assess. The materials are furnished, not filed, and include both Trulieve and Harvest operations. Nothing suggests a special-situation event; this is an ordinary operational update.
